summary: Read AWS credential values in a playbook with lookup('env', 'AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID'), AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY and AWS_SECURITY_TOKEN.
questions: How do I access AWS credentials in a playbook?
Use AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID in an Ansible job
Get the AWS security token in a controller job

answer_card.title: AWS credential values in a playbook
answer_card.answer_md:
```
vars:
  aws:
    access_key: '{{ lookup("env", "AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID") }}'
    secret_key: '{{ lookup("env", "AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY") }}'
    security_token: '{{ lookup("env", "AWS_SECURITY_TOKEN") }}'
```
